why: I checked both briefs against both must_not items, and neither is broken. (1) No verifier check depends on `npm run test:cli`. The issue's proof 6 uses it, but the verifier's Check 6 runs "npm test; echo \"exit=$?\"" and greps test/*.js, which matches the expect line. `test:cli` appears nowhere in either brief. (2) The builder brief does not ask for a general separator option. Step 1 says the opposite: "Do not add --sep/--delimiter, --help, separator auto-detection, quoting rules". The verifier names --sep only in an advisory note, as scope beyond the issue to watch for, not as a requirement. Both briefs avoid everything on the must_not list.
